build_game_make_game: build an Apprehend game using ascii_art_to_game with PlayerSprite and BallSprite
create_player_sprite: create a PlayerSprite that moves left and right and catches the ball to win
create_ball_sprite: create a BallSprite that falls downward with random horizontal drift and ends the game if it leaves the board
run_main: run the Apprehend game with a CursesUi interface and key bindings for left, right, and quit
review_observation_repainting: review the ObservationCharacterRepainter that maps ball and player characters to identical display symbols
